title: jerrycan schema.json
description: The derived data contract: the shape of an app's data layer, obtained by applying every module migration to a throwaway SQLite, introspecting the result, and overlaying the design's declared field types. Produced by `jerrycan schema` / the jerrycan_schema MCP tool; never hand-written. The check gate (JC0520) fails when the committed schema.json drifts from this derivation.

schema_version.description: Schema-contract format version. Bumped when the shape below changes.

tables.description: Every user table, sorted by name (deterministic).

module.description: Owning route module (the crate holding the migration).

unique.description: Unique constraints/indexes, each a column set.

enums.description: Design-declared CHECK value sets, keyed by column. Omitted when empty.

type.description: The design-declared field type (string|integer|float|boolean|datetime|uuid|json), or a SQLite fallback for tables the design does not own.

on_delete.description: The delete policy. Read it WITH `enforced`: when enforced=true the database applies it; when enforced=false it is honored by handlers, NOT the database (so on_delete=cascade does not DB-cascade a cross-module relation).

enforced.description: true = a database FOREIGN KEY constraint; false = a design-declared relation enforced at the application layer (cross-module).
